description: This file defines the HarRecorder class responsible for recording HTTP Archive (HAR) data during browser sessions, including managing zip files, exporting HAR logs, and handling related data serialization.

classes.name: HarRecorder
classes.description: A class that records network activity into HAR format, manages zip compression, and exports the HAR data.

methods.name: onEntryStarted
methods.description: Handles the start of a HAR entry.

methods.name: onEntryFinished
methods.description: Handles the completion of a HAR entry.

methods.name: onContentBlob
methods.description: Adds a content blob to the zip archive if applicable.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Finalizes and writes out the HAR data and zip archive.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the HAR artifact after flushing data.
